newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Berjaya Industrial says plans disposals.
newsitem.headline: Berjaya Industrial says plans disposals.

text.p: Berjaya Industrial Bhd said that it was in the process of finalising details on "proposed disposals" and that an announcement would be made once the proposals were finalised.

In a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange on Friday and received by Reuters on Monday, the company did not offer any details. In a separate announcement, affiliate company Berjaya Leisure Bhd said it was still in the process of finalising details on proposed acquisitions and that an announcement would be made once the proposals were finalised.
Both stocks have been suspended since September 5 pending company announcements. A source at Berjaya Group Bhd said last Wednesday that the companies were involved in a mutual transfer of assets.

Berjaya Group is the parent company of the two firms. Berjaya Industrial makes steel wires and related products and trades consumer durables. Berjaya Leisure's businesses include gaming and property development.
